As the sounds in your memory fall into place, their magnificent echo crosses eons to reach your ears. Throughout your journey, your identity and purposes slowly piece themselves back together, and once again, you, the Astral Modulator, return to the center stage.

In the market, Aalto floats on the boundary between buying and selling, playing different roles: investor, opportunist, and market mover. He lays chips in every corner.\nEvery investment made is an avenue of future wealth.
Planting seeds, watering and nurturing them till they sprout and bloom... That's how Verina initially imagined what the process of "Healing" meant.
Encore's paradise is in the land of imagination. Brave Wooly Warriors and their wooly companions leap from the pages of books to a "Happily Ever After."

The "hound" in the shadow stalks his prey. First, he is calm, waiting for his target to move through the crowd. Then, unease sets in as the surroundings grow eerily quiet. Finally, the fangs are bared, and the target can no longer see its own shadow.
With every step a dance, he will surely leap to the highest perch.
With a limpid mind and sustained inner peace, she, who has undergone the trials of the world, completes the final piece of the mirror. The heart is a mirror. The mirror reflects her heart.
The enemies surging in were suddenly met by a streak of blue light. Qingloong swept in with the wind, and after the storm subsided, the Midnight Rangers' flag stood tall on the high ground…
Like a puppet with a thousand faces, she walks through the shadows in different facades. But at the end of the day, she's still the one holding the strings.

It was an age when the flow of time was chaotic, with dawn blurring into dusk and the cold proving relentless.\nDoubt, weariness, and the weight of duty... such was the life of a Magistrate. Though quite young, she shouldered it all as she ascended the mountain, striving to illuminate the sky with a sliver of candlelight. It was the moment when winter relented. The thaw came, and the slopes awoke, bathed in the first tender hues of spring...
Changli wishes for an era of peace and prosperity.\nThis is the longest game of Weiqi she's ever played, and with each move, she becomes a part of the game, an eternal fire that lights the way.

Wind, though invisible in form, can be seen through the flowers it blows, the flames it caresses, and the larks it makes soar. Wind carries the birdsong high, echoing, echoing... until it is heard once more.

Xiangli Yao often describes himself as a greedy person, who is hungry for truth, yet equally starves for the warmth of human bonds.\nThough he often gazes at the stars, he occasionally casts glances at the distant mountains and the vast land they anchor. And with each step forward, he measures the distance he has traveled, the life he has lived.

She prefers colors on ink and wash, which, while not the most dazzling, still depict a stunning array of hues.\nThis is Zhezhi's true colors, that which she hopes will one day burst forth with the power to leave others in awe.\nOr at least, during self-introductions...

Starlight falls into the deep sea, filling all of her longing and emptiness. In vastness and loneliness, she stood watch over the shores that exist only because of {Male=him;Female=her}... This is her innate duty, both past and future.
Though young, Youhu can already distinguish real antiques from fakes. Valuables weighed down by time can only be cherished and cared for when entrusted to those who understand their value.
Blossom, wither, and bloom again with memories of the past. When red and white converge... What form will Camellya take when she flowers once more in your eyes?
We Promise, We Deliver!\nBright and cheerful Lumi travels across the vast land of Solaris, delivering messages from distant places to those on her route.

Before this radiant moment arrived, the "gem" had endured endless nights of rain.\nOnce, she loathed the downpower, but now she embraces the rhythm... With patient hands, she polished the rough stone that was "herself" until it shimmered with a thousand captured hues, in the name of Montelli, and more so in the name of Carlotta.
How should the stage be set for a drama? Spotlights check, curtains check, magnificent costumes? Check. "Pero Pero!" A strange box jumps up and hands her a confetti gun. "Ta-da!" —It's showtime!

Set sail! The curtain rises! This maritime stage belongs to Brant. From the bow comes the scent of "Troupe Strength" and wild laughter mocking the outdated doctrines of The Order. On deck, they're rehearsing plays banned by The Order. From the stern, the sea chases after them in pursuit.

As the sand of time flickers through your finger, please remember: in the gentle starlight, among beautiful waves, beneath the lantern... and where the kindness of your heart shines, my unspoken words are waiting for you... Listen! The door is open. It's time to move on.

The Flame Ranger still chooses to challenge an opponent who is simply unbeatable...\nThe girl behind the curtain waves a hero figurine in her hand. Whether it was the light or something else, the figurine shone brightly in her grasp.

Where does the dream end and reality begin? The moment your fingers meet the jellyfish, you're falling into a deep sea, descending ever deeper... Only to surface at last into the calm harbor of her gaze.

Listen! The chimes of a starry, starry night, a prelude to the young maid's song. Bright as midsummer sun even in the depth of the night, yet gentle as the breeze on a summer's day. The wind carries her music across the dark, a melodic story that greets the dawn.

A fixed routine isn't that bad. Stability has got to count for something. These are words Zani lives by.\nHer routine consists of work, meals, sleep, and the occasional bouts of saving the world. Life, after all, is simply a matter of style.
In the face of darkness, shadow, and fear, courage is your sharpest blade.

The wind that sweeps across mountains and seas knows no hesitation, no retreat. As steadfast as an ancient oath and as faithful as a time-forged pact, I am the blade of justice. I am the vanguard that never falters.
The Divinity spoke whispers in her ears, she swung her sword in reply. Fate has written her a script, she tore the pages to shreds.\nShe has chosen her own path through gale and tide.
Flames ignite the cheers of the arena, as the wolf tears out the throats of every shadow. She is the brightest star on the field.
The living dwell upon the dark beyond, stubbornly denying the insurmountable divide between life and death.

What is the Sun? She is the one who offers warmth and radiance without end. To this ancient land, she devotes her blood, her glory, and her life. And thus, she becomes the Sun, the eternal blaze for all to look upon.

The Moon has always been herself, long before she knew she was the Moon.\nShe no longer peers into the future through the scattered light of fate, for she understands that wherever she sets her gaze, the future she seeks awaits. Amid the countless paths of destiny, she chooses to become the one true Anchor for herself.
A bloom in snow is cold yet irresistibly tempting to touch. But in the end, it cannot escape the natural order of things, and melts away in your hand.
I am ash, I am flame; I am darkness, yet I am salvation.\nThough light falters and torments sear my flesh, still I remain true to my oath. My undying flame shall scour all evil.
A verdant edge cut from bamboo, concealed for the way, unsheathed for the cause.
Through rain and night, tracing the threads that run through all things, she severs the endless loop, spreads her arms wide, and embraces a summer no longer trapped in stillness.
I grant this Fu Talisman, purging every trace of malice, until my ears hear only clarity, where neither demon nor divinity remains.
Colors at her fingertips, wind in her ears, and the future in her gaze—her motorbike streaks a bright trail as she rides toward a dawning horizon.
Observe. Calculate. Calibrate. Extrapolate… And in the end, she reaches toward the stars.
It began as a dream that took root in a child's heart, then was folded into paper wings and cast upon the spring breeze, flying to the end of the stars.\nNow, I can finally walk beside you.
Under the frozen earth, time rusts like iron. He strips away gold, as if stripping away time itself.
Pour some yogurt into the answer, draw some oranges in the runes, spread some frosting over the future.\nThere is no right or wrong—a perfect balance of sweet and sour.

A girl who walks among the righteous and the wicked must constantly refine her sense of justice and morality. It is precisely because of this, that the jade pendant hanging from her chest remains so clear and pure.
All desires are bound by one blade. Every road leads to the same end.\nThe future that belongs to her alone shall answer her wish.
At the edge of night, someone once lit a firework. Since then, all that is bright has soared to the heavens, while all that is dim has sunk forever into the depths of dreams.
Even if it is a fleeting dream, I will show that you existed.
A girl and her iron against the world. A bundle of rage and love ready to burst, painting the city's cold concrete with a neon brilliance.
I bear witness to the silent miracle of seeds sprouting from the frozen earth. One day, they shall reach the sky.
Sit, breathe, and find inner peace. She opens her eyes to perceive the gradual stabilization of frequencies, using pupils corroded by Tacet Discords. She had walked away, free from the blizzard.

Being half a step slower also meant that Taoqi had more time to observe the world. She gradually began to notice subtle changes in the marketplace. A brick was missing here. A flower had wilted there. The next season would arrive when she was aware.
Many people light fires they cannot hope to contain.\nBut he is the creator of fire, the master of fire, and the smotherer of fire.

Even amidst the shattered mirage, you still manage to build a haven of peace.
Just as you once witnessed in the simulation, that towering tide will one day descend, engulfing all. But this time, you are ready to face it again.

speaker: NPC #701105
anh_en: Septimont is so beautiful... People drinking their fill, laughing their hearts out. So unrestrained, so full of life.

speaker: NPC #701105
anh_en: Laurus Salad is as delicious as ever. And the wheat juice here is quite good, too... heheh.

speaker: NPC #701105
anh_en: Before the High Tide surges in the hunting grounds, let's take a moment to enjoy this moment.

speaker: NPC #701105
anh_en: Hear that? The cool breeze through the golden flags and wind chimes… that gentle, beautiful ring.

speaker: NPC #701106
anh_en: I've already submitted a full report on everything that happened at the Fabricatorium of the Deep.

speaker: NPC #701106
anh_en: Had to pull some overtime to get it done… but it was worth every minute.

speaker: NPC #701106
anh_en: After all, this is a major issue. It concerns the safety of all Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #701106
anh_en: Don't worry. Go ahead and investigate over in Septimont.

speaker: NPC #701106
anh_en: Ragunna has us on its side.

speaker: NPC #701107
anh_en: My dear friend, have you made it to the campfire at the hunting grounds?
This victory belongs to every one of us.
I'm still turning over what must come after.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Yes, I can feel the energy in the air.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Yes... I'm still turning over the matter of the Sentinel's Relic.

speaker: NPC #701107
anh_en: Take it easy. Rest well, and you'll find the strength to head back into the fray.

speaker: NPC #701107
anh_en: The firelight reflects the trust between us. Only when we stand together will the banner of Septimont stand tall forever.

speaker: NPC #701107
anh_en: No matter what dangers lie ahead, know that you may contact me at any time.

speaker: NPC #701107
anh_en: I would not miss a single chance to fight beside you.

speaker: NPC #701108
anh_en: The honey wine I drank beneath that triumphant rain of petals was the sweetest I've ever tasted.
Is it because we came back from the brink of death?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Is it because we've just emerged from the Chaos between life and death, between existence and oblivion?

speaker: NPC #701108
anh_en: Hmm. I didn't think I could still drink Septimontian honey wine one day.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Don't tell me it's simply because it was poured by yours truly?

speaker: NPC #701108
anh_en: With every sip, I can feel myself existing again. Even though "fate" never did sign off on this moment...

speaker: NPC #701108
anh_en: To hell with it! Let's go overturn more destined futures together, Unwritten!

speaker: NPC #701109
anh_en: Since leaving the Black Shores, I'm still the same as ever. Seeking. Chasing. Hunting...

speaker: NPC #701109
anh_en: But my state of mind isn't the same as it was before...

speaker: NPC #701109
anh_en: Maybe it's because of this Blake Bloom on my shoulder...

speaker: NPC #701109
anh_en: It reminds me I'm not alone anymore.

speaker: NPC #701111
anh_en: The ship carrying us away is steadier than the one that brought us here.

speaker: NPC #701111
anh_en: The sea is calm. Good for quieting the mind.

speaker: NPC #701110
anh_en: The threat of the Dark Tide is gone, and our rebuilding efforts are now mostly complete.

speaker: NPC #701110
anh_en: Ragunna and Septimont will forever remember what you did for us.

speaker: NPC #701116
anh_en: Looks like I'll be spending some extra time at the Black Shores and in Honami City.

speaker: NPC #701116
anh_en: Let's treat this as a little vacation before we head back to campus, okay?

speaker: NPC #701116
anh_en: Namipon says there are still a lot of unresolved issues here in Honami.

speaker: NPC #701116
anh_en: If you're interested, we could look into it.

speaker: NPC #701116
anh_en: Of course, we'll do it together.

speaker: NPC #701095
anh_en: Huanglong is made up of the capital and six cities. As the youngest among them, Jinzhou is a key fortress guarding the border, a frontline against Tacet Discords.

speaker: NPC #701095
anh_en: Under the blessing of Sentinel Jué and the protection of the Midnight Rangers, Jinzhou has forged a unique cultural character despite its perilous surroundings.

speaker: NPC #701095
anh_en: Whether you're just passing through or thinking of calling this place your home, we hope you will enjoy your time in Jinzhou.

speaker: NPC #701096
anh_en: Frequency reading complete. Access privileges confirmed.

speaker: NPC #701097
anh_en: When the moon is full, the roving one returns...

speaker: NPC #701097
anh_en: You really are the "One Who Returned." And together, we did slay that monster. We fought our way through the long night and emerged victorious.

speaker: NPC #701097
anh_en: Because of this, Jinzhou is safe. The spirits of the Midnight Rangers can finally rest easy... both those who fell in this battle and those lost in the Retroact Rain three years ago.

speaker: NPC #701097
anh_en: I will continue to stand guard over Norfall Barrens. I will protect this land we defended together.

speaker: NPC #701097
anh_en: That is my duty. And it is how I thank you.
Changli invited {PlayerName} and Jinhsi to the group chat.
It's all thanks to the Wayfinder for guiding us to the end.
You and Jinhsi have both done so much.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: If Jinhsi hadn't risked everything in that fight, neither Mt. Firmament nor Jinzhou would have survived this.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: If you hadn't guided us through the maze, we'd have been lost forever in those tangled Temporal Disruptions.

speaker: NPC #701098
anh_en: I merely showed the way. Our span of life is heaven's decree... There is no need to brood.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: This wasn't my sole achievement. You and Jinhsi have both worked hard.

speaker: NPC #701098
anh_en: Time fell into disarray, the firmament stood still... Yet a single candle's flame managed to set the heavens alight.

speaker: NPC #701098
anh_en: The Magistrate staked her life in this struggle to correct the flow of time, and at last wrested a sliver of hope for Jinzhou...

speaker: NPC #701098
anh_en: Fellow traveler, honored guest, Arbiter... With so many titles, what should I call you?

speaker: NPC #701099
anh_en: Now that time is flowing again, we can once more feel Jinzhou's clear spring days and its snowy winters...

speaker: NPC #701099
anh_en: {PlayerName}, would you stay here a little longer?

speaker: NPC #701099
anh_en: There are still so many beautiful places in Jinzhou. Once I've fully recovered, I want to visit them with you.

speaker: NPC #701098
anh_en: I hope you'll take care of yourself in the meantime, Jinhsi.

speaker: NPC #701098
anh_en: Heh, after what we just went through together… I believe we're close enough to call each other by name.

speaker: NPC #701098
anh_en: {PlayerName}, at Mt. Firmament… thank you for stepping in.
It's all thanks to Jinhsi for buying us the time.

speaker: NPC #701100
anh_en: Perhaps these cold lines of text cannot carry the warmth of sunlight.

speaker: NPC #701100
anh_en: Right now, I wonder if I might modify this messaging Terminal.
Let's not burden Tethys System with this.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: No, no, this is fine. Talking like this still feels like I'm talking with you in person.

speaker: NPC #701100
anh_en: I see. Then I suppose it's fine then.

speaker: NPC #701100
anh_en: But please, keep seeking the starlight that binds the world together.

speaker: NPC #701100
anh_en: I will stay here, on this shore, guarding everything you once left behind.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Please continue to listen for the rising tides.

speaker: NPC #701100
anh_en: If you can connect to Tethys, it might make things easier for you...

speaker: NPC #701100
anh_en: All in all… From now on, let me share the road with you.

speaker: NPC #701101
anh_en: With the Carnevale about to begin, Ragunna—the Nation of a Thousand Islands, the City of Echoes—warmly welcomes every visitor.

speaker: NPC #701101
anh_en: Please adhere to the Order of the Deep's rules while taking in Ragunna's unique charm.

speaker: NPC #701101
anh_en: May Sentinel Imperator be with you.

speaker: NPC #701102
anh_en: Here, glory is forged. Welcome to the City of Gladiators—Septimont!

speaker: NPC #701102
anh_en: In the name of glory, fear no death... The Great Agon is now in full swing!

speaker: NPC #701102
anh_en: If that piques your interest, be sure to head over to the arena and experience the thrill of the Agon for yourself.

speaker: NPC #701102
anh_en: May applause greet the warriors who've come from afar!

speaker: NPC #701103
anh_en: One more thing. As for what concerns you, I've already had my family begin investigations.

speaker: NPC #701103
anh_en: If I learn anything, I'll be sure to contact you. We'll plan our next moves accordingly.

speaker: NPC #701103
anh_en: Oh yes. And should anything stand in your way while in Ragunna City, you need only to invoke the Montelli name. I've got your back.

speaker: NPC #701103
anh_en: At the Carnevale, we pulled off a damn near perfect performance.

speaker: NPC #701103
anh_en: I'm in no rush to end our fun just yet... How about a couple of drinks? I've made you a very special concoction.

speaker: NPC #701103
anh_en: We'll be waiting for you in the cafeteria.

speaker: NPC #701104
anh_en: Cartethyia has found herself again, and the Fisalias have their freedom.

speaker: NPC #701104
anh_en: All of this is thanks to you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #701104
anh_en: Aside from the Bloodpact's Pledge, if there is something else you want... come find me at Porto-Veno Castle.

speaker: NPC #701104
anh_en: Hmm... what shall I arrange for you? A full spread of the Fisalia's signature tea, or perhaps a private ball, spun straight from a dream…

speaker: NPC #701104
anh_en: You'll find out when you get here.

Scattered across Xuanfang Hold, Auto Caskets can be used to obtain Automatons.\nTo restore the Auto Empire to its former glory, retrieve them all!

Upon entering the game, all items inside the Auto Casket will continuously cycle along the carousel.

You can control the Deft Grabber to position it within the Auto Casket. After predicting an item's movement path and timing the moment correctly, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Grab button to release the Deft Grabber. It will descend and perform a grab as it approaches the platform. Once an item is successfully captured, you need to move the Deft Grabber again to align it above the central drop zone. Release the item, and if it lands in the collection slot, the grab is considered successful.

Each Auto Casket challenge is time-limited. When the countdown reaches zero, no further actions can be taken. During the challenge, you can extend the timer by using the Deft Grabber to interact with the Time Dial inside the Casket.

Challenges are divided into Standard Mode and Endless Mode: In Standard Mode, successfully grabbing items directly grants rewards. Once all items in the Casket are collected, the machine will automatically shut down. In Endless Mode, items and Time Dials continuously respawn. The machine remains active, allowing free play until the timer expires. Items in this mode do not grant direct rewards; instead, they are converted into Challenge Points. Reaching specific point thresholds unlocks valuable rewards such as Astrites.
